data_sources.notes: growth_habit='upright' inferred by Ollama (Trefle growth_habit is bare 'Forb/herb' - ambiguous between upright/rosette/spreading, deferred to Ollama); reasoning: Basil typically grows as an upright clump of leaves and stems from the ground.
life_cycle='annual' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Basil is typically grown as an annual in Belgium because it is sensitive to frost and does not survive the winter outdoors.
edible_parts=['leaves'] inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Basil is commonly grown for its aromatic leaves which are used in cooking.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['leaves'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.

plant_spacing_cm substituted from row_spacing_cm (GitHub issue #170: no source distinguishes in-row plant spacing from row spacing for this plant) - NOT an independently-sourced value, just a carried-over placeholder.
